claimed_purpose.text: Open-source user-memory backend (memodb-io/memobase): ingest chat blobs, extract/update structured user profiles (topic/subtopic slots) plus events/gists, and serve turn-ready context for LLM apps—profile-first rather than full transcript replay.

mechanisms.text: Store: User Profile (structured slots) and User Events / event gists (timeline with mention vs happen time); raw GeneralBlob chat can be dropped after flush per config—curated memory vs message log.
Write: buffer until size/idle/manual flush → LLM extraction/merge (merge.py); async_insert path; issues #143/#109 contest dedup and retention reliability.

Retrieve: context API packs profile + events under token budgets (profile_event_ratio); profile_filter/search and semantic event search; scaffold suppresses unprompted recall unless the query is relevant.
Forget: hard delete APIs for profile rows and user events; no soft-hide path documented in harvested controllers.
Isolation: scoped by user_id + project_id; roleplay proactive topics + HN community signal companion-adjacent use, but product remains a decoupled API layer.

ledger.claim: Write path is asynchronous by default; flush is batch-triggered off the hot path
ledger.quote: In Memobase, we don't memoize users in hot path. We use buffer zones for the recent inserted blobs. When the buffer zone becomes too large (e.g., 1024 tokens) or remains idle for an extended period (e.g., 1 hour), Memobase will flush the entire buffer into memory.

ledger.claim: Multiple injection approaches (MCP server description as prompt, MCP sampling, OpenAPI spec for ChatGPT) failed; only explicit system-prompt configuration by the user worked.
